id: Kontrol sentuh di HP: joystick kiri, tombol Pukul / Tendang / Lompat / Hindar
Layar HP lebih besar: stage memenuhi lebar layar saat tegak
Bayu: combo 4 pukulan sampai Tendangan Sabit, sapuan, tendangan terbang
en: Touch controls on phones: left joystick, Punch / Kick / Jump / Dodge buttons
Bigger picture on phones: the stage fills the screen width in portrait
Bayu: 4-hit combo ending in Tendangan Sabit, sweep, flying kick
